# Protocolith

> Protocolith records, verifies and issues trial records: a protocol is frozen before a run, results go into a hash-chained ledger, the history is verified, and evidence cards are issued. Python, standard library only. CLI, Python API and MCP server (stdio).

## Docs
- [Documentation](https://protocolith.github.io/protocolith/docs/): guides, reference, specification
- [AI agent guide (MCP)](https://protocolith.github.io/protocolith/docs/guides/ai-agent-mcp/): tools, resources, prompts
- [Core specification](https://github.com/Protocolith/protocolith/blob/main/docs/spec/CORE_SPEC.md): ledger format, rules, error codes

## Code
- [Repository](https://github.com/Protocolith/protocolith): source, issues, discussions
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/protocolith/): `pip install protocolith`

## Rules for agents
- Freeze the protocol before any run; record every run, including failures and blocked sources.
- Call claim-check before stating a result and use its wording (protocolith_claim_check).
- Before publishing anything from a private ledger, call protocolith_disclose with a policy that names what is public (default hidden), then anchor the head.
- Never report a result that is not in the ledger; never turn missing data into a negative result.
